content: कुसी(सि)द {%a.%} Lazy, slothful. .{@-दः@} (also written as कुशी(षी)द) A money-lender, usurer; <ls>Mbh. 4. 29</ls>. .{@-दम्@} .²1 Any loan or thing lent to be repaid with interest. .²2 Lending money, usury, the profession of usury; कुसीदाद् दारिद्र्यं परकरगतग्रन्थिशमनात् <ls>Pt. 1. 11</ls>; <ls>Ms. 1. 90</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">8. 410</ls>; <ls>Y. 1. 119</ls>. .²3 Red sandalwood.
